title: Understand your Business Profile performance & insights - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Google states that Business Profile performance data is available only for verified Business Profiles.
facts.quote: Performance data is available only for verified Business Profiles.

facts.fact: Google states that the searches metric is updated at the start of each month and may take up to 5 days to appear.
facts.quote: The searches metric is updated at the start of each month. It might take up to 5 days to show up.

facts.fact: Google states that a person is counted at most once per day in the Views metric for Business Profile views on Search and Maps.
facts.quote: A person can only be counted once a day.

facts.fact: Google states that the Menus metric counts clicks on menu content per user, per day, including menu photos, menu links, and structured menu data.
facts.quote: The number of times people clicked on the menu content per user, per day.

facts.fact: Google states that the Calls metric only tracks calls if the business has added a phone number to its Business Profile.
facts.quote: Add your phone number to track this metric.

facts.fact: Google states that the Bookings metric only returns data when bookings are managed through a booking provider.
facts.quote: To get data for this metric, your bookings must be managed through a booking provider.

facts.fact: Google states that the Booking clicks metric applies only to hotels.
facts.quote: This metric only applies for hotels.

facts.fact: Google states that the hotel price comparison overview shows the average of the cheapest rate across providers for the next 30 days.
facts.quote: The overview comparison shows the average of the cheapest rate across providers for the next 30 days.

facts.fact: Google states that performance data includes views, searches, and actions from both organic search results and Google Ads.
facts.quote: Performance data includes views, searches, and actions from both organic search results and Google Ads.

facts.fact: Google states that the Insights feature may not be available for all Business Profiles.
facts.quote: The Insights feature may not be available for all Business Profiles.
